examples.scenario: Approximate statistics computed from an overview miss a one-cell native-resolution peak
examples.reason: Subsampled statistics cannot prove native-grid minima or maxima.

examples.scenario: Cached STATISTICS_MAXIMUM belongs to an older raster blob with the same filename
examples.reason: Metadata without byte-identical provenance can be stale.

examples.scenario: Every parcel cell is masked, NoData or nonfinite
examples.reason: No extrema or height difference exists for empty valid support.

examples.scenario: Five cells share the exact decoded minimum but argmin returns one index
examples.reason: First-occurrence reduction loses valid extrema provenance.

examples.scenario: Three cells share the exact decoded maximum but argmax returns one index
examples.reason: Every exact tied maximum must remain auditable.

examples.scenario: Parallel block completion order changes while the tie set is unchanged
examples.reason: Deterministic row-major ordering separates result identity from worker timing.

examples.scenario: Default isclose merges two distinct small elevation values
examples.reason: Default absolute tolerance can be inappropriate and cannot define canonical equality.

examples.scenario: Values are rounded before reduction and a distinct maximum becomes a tie
examples.reason: Early presentation rounding can change extrema identity and tie counts.
